Neither is about Qi2.2 under $60 specifically; Digital Trends is a deal post, the Macworld single review is a 15W Qi2 bank, the Verge copies are unreadable/spam, and The Gadgeteer and Powerbanks.fyi compare without their own tests. A focused sub-$60 Qi2.2 page could get in but would compete with Macworld and Android Central.
